'''Shane Watner slim in the court''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Shane Watner]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-5622">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5622 slim in the court], DeckTech (Shane "Outlaw" Watner, 18 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5622/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5622/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018182719/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5622/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shane Watner]]
* '''Published:''' 18 April 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''slim in the court''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Vile Watner DS 2000 5622.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is a all around good deck.  It has counters for a lot f stuff people are using today.  I'm really am not trying to flip the objective either.

== Original post ==

'''slim in the court'''
* '''Author:''' Shane "Outlaw" Watner
* '''Published:''' April 18, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is a all around good deck.  It has counters for a lot f stuff people are using today.  I'm really am not trying to flip the objective either.

=== Strategy ===

Use Scum and Villiany along with First Strike to gain 3 force each time you initiate.  You may use Projective Telepathy to cancel the battles you initiate just to get the force back.  Use Death Mark on their Han or other smuggler on the Great Pit with the Sarlacc there.  Everything else is self explanatory.
